mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, compressing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in over 55% of cases when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns falls below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%) triggers market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in over 55% of cases when INDPRO rises, or the correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ annualized > 3.0%) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicate a tight labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the housing recovery phase (HOUST > 1500 thousand units), rising housing starts boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns is below 0.1.
